# PLAN — iteration 6
## Current state assessment
Iteration 3 is the verified incumbent at 79 LUTs, 202 FFs, WNS 1.645 ns and WHS 0.118 ns. Iterations 4 and 5 passed behavior and timing but regressed to 178 and 105 LUTs, so avoid repeating their product-register and sum-width narrowing. The current top has known latency 5 and requires `// @latency 5`; promotion still requires all verification and metric gates, and a LUT objective improvement over the incumbent.

## Hypothesis
Writing the input-ready condition as one six-input Boolean function may reduce LUT use in the ready cone while preserving the five-slot elastic behavior.

## Instruction for generator
In `fir16_sym_core`, replace the recursive `ready1 = !v1 || ready2` assignment with the equivalent direct expression `ready1 = !(v1 && v2 && v3 && v4 && v5) || out_ready`; keep `ready2` through `ready5` and all slot update conditions unchanged. Preserve the specified ready behavior, handshakes, stalls, reset and cycle behavior, and the top’s `// @latency 5` annotation. The expected benefit is a smaller or shallower ready cone; retain the candidate only if routed LUTs strictly improve over the incumbent and every deterministic gate passes.
